items.meeting: City of Coldwater, Planning Commission and CBPU Board
items.bullet: Coldwater joint meeting Monday to shape permanent data center zoning rules after rejecting temporary freeze, with no active proposals on file.
Caledonia PC discusses data center ordinance Aug. 17 while moratorium holds until Oct. 17 after earlier extension recommendation.
Kalamazoo Commission votes Aug. 17 on data center moratorium resolution after June opposition and no formal proposals submitted.
